title: Lamp Room
brief: A first-person exploration game: mouse look and WASD walk through a lighthouse, find three notes, read each one, then climb to the lamp room. In GameState count notes_found and notes_read, set stairs_lit when the lamp is switched on, and set won to true in the lamp room. There is no lose state, and no visible avatar because the camera is the player.
artDirection: Cold sea light through tall windows, warm brass lamp room, legible note pages, no floating body parts in view.

obligations.description: Walking up to a note picks it up and raises notes_found.
Opening a picked-up note raises notes_read.
Switching on the lamp room sets stairs_lit.
Reaching the lamp room with the lamp lit wins the climb.
The camera is the player; the frames show no floating avatar or third-person body.
obligations.unsupported: The visual rubric asks for a visible player, hazard and goal in frames and scores readability from them; an avatarless first-person view has no player silhouette for the current judge to score.

obligations.description: Mouse look turns the view without walking the player.
obligations.unsupported: Camera rotation is not a scalar GameState value and the route format has no relative pointer look, so turning the view cannot be observed as a distinct action.
